sinopsis.es: Un astuto zorro, el señor Fox, parece llevar una vida idílica con su esposa y su hijo Ash. Pero, por las noches, se dedica a robar gallinas, patos y pavos en las granjas vecinas. Los granjeros deciden acabar con la situación cazándolo. Basada en el famoso libro para niños de Roald Dahl.
sinopsis.en: A cunning fox, Mr. Fox, seems to lead an idyllic life with his wife and his son Ash. But at night he steals chickens, ducks and turkeys from the neighboring farms. The farmers decide to put an end to it by hunting him down. Based on the famous children's book by Roald Dahl.
